name: Torya Longshanks
description: A farmer-soldier who ends King Rogan's curse.

description_citations.text: "Distant Planes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Torya ends King Rogan's nightly monster curse by scraping her hand on the beast and stays to help him rule.
timeline.quote: She stays to help the king become a good ruler, and he welcomes her.

citation.text: "Distant Planes", section "A Monstrous Duty , by Kathleen Dalton-Woodbury". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
